effects: Sets the signer's POOL delegate to `delegatee`, replacing any earlier delegate (Pool.sol _delegate: delegates[delegator] = delegatee).

Moves all the signer's current POOL voting weight from the old delegate to `delegatee`, and future balance changes follow the new delegate (_moveDelegates(currentDelegate, delegatee, delegatorBalance)).
A `delegatee` of address(0) removes the signer's voting weight from any delegate and gives it to no one (_moveDelegates skips dstRep == address(0)).
Uses up the signer's nonce. Permit uses the same nonces mapping (delegateBySig: require(nonce == nonces[signatory]++)).
The signature works only until `expiry`, and anyone can submit it (require(now <= expiry)).
formats.shown: "Delegate POOL voting power", with the delegatee address, the nonce and the expiry shown as raw values.

findings.title: Delegation: expiry is shown as a raw Unix timestamp, not as a date.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json field {"path":"expiry","label":"Expiry","format":"raw"}; case 0 screen shows Expiry "1784678400". Pool.sol delegateBySig: require(now <= expiry).
findings.fix: Use "format": "date" with "params": {"encoding": "timestamp"} and the label "Valid until".

findings.title: Delegation: there is no interpolatedIntent, so the intent line never names who gets the voting power.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json format has only "intent": "Delegate POOL voting power" and no interpolatedIntent. Pool.sol _delegate sends the full voting weight to delegatee.
findings.fix: Add "interpolatedIntent": "Delegate POOL voting power to {delegatee}" and format delegatee as addressName.

findings.title: Delegation: delegatee uses raw format instead of addressName, so wallets cannot resolve or check the address.
Delegation: the screen cannot show that the zero-address delegatee revokes voting power.
findings.evidence: Pool.sol _moveDelegates: `if (dstRep != address(0))` skips adding votes, so delegating to 0x0 removes them all. The descriptor has no label for this value.
findings.fix: If a wallet supports it, show 0x0 as "None (remove delegation)". Otherwise note it in the label.
